example.title: A good example
example.basics:
Title: "AgroSmart Fergana: solar-powered greenhouses"
Tagline: "A greenhouse in Kuva that uses 78% less water — tomatoes for Fergana and Tashkent markets."
The title says what and where. The tagline says who it's for and why it helps.
example.story:
Paragraph 1 — the problem: "Water in the Fergana Valley is running low, and furrow irrigation wastes most of it."
Paragraph 2 — the solution and proof: "Our test greenhouse has run two seasons using 4× less water."
Paragraph 3 — what the money pays for and what backers get.
Numbers, place names and real photos build trust.
example.budget:
One line per expense:
• Greenhouse frames and cover — 96 000 000 so'm (steel arches, polycarbonate)
• Solar panels — 60 000 000 so'm (15 kW, inverter, batteries)
• Workers and transport — 12 000 000 so'm
Avoid vague lines like "Other costs".
example.milestones:
Each stage is a result someone can check:
1. Foundation ready — month 1 — 30%
2. Frame and panels installed — month 2 — 40%
3. First crop planted — month 3 — 20%
4. First harvest delivered to shops — month 5 — 10%
Proof: photos, video, an invoice or a signed handover act.
example.terms:
Reward: "A hand-made piyola — 350 000 so'm, delivered December 2026, 100 available".
Musharakah: "28% of net profit to backers, every quarter, for 5 years. Minimum share 2 500 000 so'm".
Write exact terms, not promises.
example.founder:
"Graduate of Tashkent State Agrarian University. Has built greenhouse systems for 11 years: 3 in Kuva, 2 in Turkey."
Write the full registration number: "LLC certificate No. 309812490".

ngo.payout: A bank account in the organisation's name

organizer.payLaterShort: No company yet? Investors pledge now and pay after you register an MChJ.
organizer.payLaterRule: Musharakah without a company: investors pledge and allow us to charge their card later; nothing is taken now. If you reach your goal, register an MChJ within 60 days and add its number. Our team checks it, and the cards are charged the day after your registration deadline. If you don't register in time, no card is charged.

identity.title: Confirm who you are
identity.noUpload: No passport upload. Sign in with OneID (id.egov.uz) and your name and passport details come from the government record. Only the review team sees them.
identity.videoCallMeanwhile: Until OneID is connected, our team confirms who you are on a short video call while reviewing your project. Have your passport or ID card at hand.
identity.oneidFailed: The OneID check didn't work. Please try again.

confirmedBy.video_call: Confirmed by the Fundy team on a video call on {{date}}.

payLater.label: pay after registration
payLater.dialog: The founder has no company yet, so nothing is taken now. If the goal is reached, the founder has {{days}} days to register an MChJ. Your card is charged once, on {{date}} (the day after that deadline), only if the company was registered. If not, nothing is charged.

note.active: No company yet: investors pledge now and nothing is taken. If the goal is reached, the founder has {{days}} days to register an MChJ; cards are charged the day after that deadline, only if they did.
note.registering: Goal reached. The founder is registering a company (by {{date}}). Cards are charged on {{charge}}, only if they do.
note.registered: The company is registered. Investors’ cards are charged on {{date}}.
note.charged: Cards were charged. Investors whose payment failed can pay by hand until {{date}}.

backer.noMoneyYet: Nothing taken. Your card is charged only if the company is registered.
backer.waitingCompany: Waiting for the company (by {{date}}). Nothing is charged if it isn’t registered.
backer.payConfirm: Pay {{amount}} now? (Demo: no real money moves.)
backer.chargeOn: Company registered. Your card will be charged on {{date}}.
backer.chargeFailed: Your card payment didn’t go through

founder.active: Investors pledge now and no money is taken yet. If you reach the goal, you will have 60 days to register an MChJ.
founder.register: Goal reached! Register an MChJ by {{date}} and add its number here. You can register online at my.gov.uz. If you don't, no investor's card is charged and the pledges are cancelled.
founder.checking: Thank you. Our team is checking your company. Investors' cards are charged the day after your registration deadline.
founder.paying: Cards were charged. Investors whose payment failed can pay until {{date}}; after that their pledges drop out.
founder.confirmed: Company confirmed. Investors' cards are charged on {{date}}.

payLater.allowCharge: I allow Fundy to charge my card on {{date}}, only if the founder registers a company by then. If the charge fails, I have 7 days to pay by hand.

receipt.title: Donation receipt
receipt.thanks: Thank you for your support. Keep this receipt for your records.
receipt.note: Demo: payments are simulated and no real money was charged. This receipt is not a tax document.

soon.reward: Backers pre-order products from makers. Coming after donations.
soon.equity: Interest-free investment in real businesses, with profit sharing. Coming after donations.
soon.organizer: Coming soon, together with rewards and Musharakah.
soon.homeText: We start with donations. Next, two more ways to fund good work in Uzbekistan, with the same checks and stage-by-stage payouts.
